# s3n: the batches with the plans of the inserts as before step 1, with the
# budget of their caller. Applied to persistent_batches.go of a worktree at
# step 3 or later.
import sys
path = sys.argv[1]
text = open(path).read()
old1 = "\tplanCtx := concurrency.CtxWithBudget(ctx, 1)\n\tentries := make([]*batchEntry, 0, len(ids))\n"
new1 = "\tplanCtx := ctx\n\tentries := make([]*batchEntry, 0, len(ids))\n"
old2 = "\tplanCtx := concurrency.CtxWithBudget(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 1)\n\tp.writeMu.Lock()\n"
new2 = "\tplanCtx := context.WithoutCancel(ctx)\n\tp.writeMu.Lock()\n"
assert text.count(old1) == 1 and text.count(old2) == 1
text = text.replace(old1, new1).replace(old2, new2)
if "concurrency." not in text:
    text = text.replace('\t"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/concurrency"\n', "")
open(path, "w").write(text)
